title: Chapter 358 Where Have You Been
content:
Chapter 358 Where Have You Been

A few days ago, as the last Heavenly Supreme Powerful Man in the Chaos Realm failed to attack the Supreme Realm and fell, the human race completely fell into the darkest moment.

Countless large clans used their clan's power to press towards the human territory.

This move to take advantage of the situation was not only not despised by the strong, but also attracted more powerful people.

It is just because the human race in the Chaos Realm was once strong for a while, and there must be a stunning inheritance hidden in the ancestral land of the human race.

This is something that no strong man in the Chaos Realm cannot refuse.

On that day, the human race was enemies all over the world and was forced to the ancestral land of the human race by the people, and survived.

"You and the human race, don't make unnecessary struggles anymore. Just surrender, and maybe there will be a way out!"

A creature with a strong aura stood outside the ancestral land of the human race, with a domineering momentum. Looking at the human race in the ancestral land, his eyes were filled with mockery.

In the ancestral land, all the human race looked at each other with glaring, wishing to eat the flesh to destroy the race.

Outside the ancestral land, another powerful creature stood up, swept his contemptuous eyes to the entire human race, and he spoke indifferently, "The little human race, the ability to survive to this day is already pity for our strong race, and now we are angry. The fortune is about to end, and I still want to survive."

Hearing this, the human race could no longer bear it.

An old senior from the human race walked slowly to the barrier of the ancestral land with an old pace. His turbid eyes looked extremely sharp at this moment.

He glared at the robbers of all races outside the ancestral land and shouted coldly: "I think my human race was so strong back then. There were so many strong people in the clan as the stars in the sky. Anyone who walked out would be enough for the races such as Miaoer. Millions of times.”

"At that time, I wonder if you still have the courage to treat me human race now?"

What this old man of the human race has been said is that it was a human race a long time ago. Many young people of the human race have no idea about it.

When the tribes outside the ancestral land heard this, they couldn't help laughing.

"No matter what you say, your human race is now destructive!"

yes.

So what if you are stronger back then? It’s just the past.

Everyone in the human race lowered their heads, their expressions a little dim.

At this time, the creature who despised the human race spoke again, his voice even more arrogant than the last time.

"The human race is strong? No, that's just an illusion before your human race perishes. Even when your human race is strongest, I can beat your entire human race alone!"

Proud.

What arrogance this is.

The strong men of the tribe looked at the creature with a hint of admiration in their eyes.

They never had such an invincible mentality.

But in the eyes of some older generations of the human race, these are just newborn calfs who are not afraid of tigers and frogs in the well.

However, they have no way to refute it.

A deep sense of powerlessness filled the hearts of the human race.

At this time, an old human senior suddenly turned around and knelt down to the statue of the human ancestor in the human ancestral land, with a pious expression.

"Old ancestor, have you really left me?"

"Please show your power and protect the human race!"

Seeing this, everyone hurriedly stepped forward and knelt down.

"Please let my ancestors show their powers and protect the human race!!!"

At this moment, the human race is united and prays for a miracle to happen.

But time passed minute by minute, but there was no movement in the statue of the Renzu.

Everyone's hearts sink to the bottom again.

"Hahaha, your human race has come to death!!"

The clans stopped talking and began to bombard the barriers of the human ancestral land.

For a moment, there was a constant roar.

The human race in the barrier was getting heavier.

At this moment, they were ready to fight to the death, even the younger generation of the human race.

This is the life and death of the human race in the Chaos Realm.

.........

"Here we come to protect the human race from peace forever."

This faint sound spread throughout the Chaos Realm and kept echoing in everyone's ears.

The strong people of the human race were ecstatic.

Keep the human race peaceful forever!

The ancestors really appeared.

Although they did not recognize this mysterious strong man, they knew that this was a real human strongman.

Their human race is the strongest.

The other races naturally heard this sentence. For a moment, countless fearful eyes turned into countless torrents and rushed towards Lu Daosheng in the void.

The same was true for the golden-eyed creature standing not far from Lu Daosheng. He looked at Lu Daosheng, and his hands behind him slowly clenched into fists. He frantically mobilized the energy in his body, and looked at Lu Daosheng's golden eyes. flash.

Immediately afterwards, Lu Dao became vivid.

For a moment, the hearts of all living beings were beating for half a beat.

I saw Lu Daosheng slowly heading towards the place where the human race is below.

It was an area close to the center of the Chaos Realm, and the tragic battle was constantly permeated around it.

Obviously, a big war happened here not long ago.

But what Lu Daosheng saw was more than that. He could see that the area where the human race was located had traces of movement.

Long time ago, this area was obviously in the central area of the Chaos Realm.

"I'll wait, I've seen senior!"

Lu Daosheng had just arrived above the human ancestral land, and there were loud noises coming from the lower house.

The human race looked at Lu Daosheng devoutly.

Feeling countless hopeful gazes and looking at the fear of the tribes outside the ancestral land, Lu Daosheng let out a light breath, and then a mark slowly appeared in his hand.

The next moment, the mark began to slowly dissipate.

Everyone was puzzled, what was the operation.

At the same time, the distant starry sky over the other side.

A huge city stands in the starry sky, and from time to time, a sacred aura comes from inside, making people unable to help but worship.

Today, the deserted city has become a forbidden city.

Blue Star’s time tassels are completely different from those in the outside world.

Lu Daosheng has passed by endless years since he traveled through time, but when he returned to Blue Star, it has only been a few years.

And this time, Lu Daosheng spent decades on Blue Star, and countless epochs have naturally passed by the outside world.

In the deserted city.

The once lively streets now seem a little lonely.

The bustling pedestrians walked on the road, their eyes filled with peaceful gazes.

This is not that there is no one in the deserted city, but that everyone has begun a long retreat practice.

When Lu Daosheng hadn't come back for so long, everyone had already realized something.

One day after that, the city lord will definitely need them one day.

Therefore, under the leadership of the three major families in the inner city, everyone began to enter the era of asceticism.

And now, the strength of Huangcheng has undergone earth-shaking changes from the past.

The deepest part of the deserted city.

In the city lord's mansion.

In the pure hall, a woman with an ethereal breath slowly opened her moving eyes, with vicissitudes of life.

"Dad, why are you still not informed after so many years?"

"Dad, where did you go?"

Lu Xue's voice was a little cold, but full of longing.
